Name: Ori's Portraits(High resolution version)
Author: duckmydock
Description:
I made Abigail, Alex, Emily, Haley, Leah, Maru, Penny, Sandy's Portrait!



I wanted to do all the characters. But i gave up because it was so hard.
But single male characters can be uploaded sometime.

I like the Retro pixel of the Stardew Valley and gave similar effects to high resolution images. 



This portrait has a high resolution version(png) and a small version(xnb)

+ 2018.10.28/ Added CP version!
+ 2018.10.29/ Found a problem with the CP version not working. I recovered a broken file.
+ 2018.10.30/ Found a problem of High-res Haley's Portrait and CP version to penny and Maru. Modified and re-uploaded.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]
[b]◆ [/b]High resolution version[/b]

Need Portraiture mod  + Download here  > https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999

 Downlode .png file and into [Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits]
[b] [/b]

[b]◆ Small size version[/b]

Choose the way you want.

1.

If you do not use the SMAPI
Downlode .xnb file and Paste into [Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits][b] [/b]

Don't forget to back up your original files!

[b]2.[/b]

Need Content Patcher + Download here  > https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915
Downlode CP file and into [Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods]

You do not need to back up the original files.
